rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Cantonese word for a bikini.

example.english: I bought a bikini to go to the beach.
example.traditional: 我買咗套比堅尼去沙灘。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 tou3 bei2 gin1 nei4 heoi3 saa1 taan1

rows.note: A speaker uses 三點式 when emphasizing the revealing two-piece style rather than simply naming the garment.

example.english: This bikini leaves the navel completely exposed; it’s really daring.
example.traditional: 呢套三點式露晒個肚臍，真係好大膽。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 saam1 dim2 sik1 lou6 saai3 go3 tou5 ci4 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 daam2
